interview.hardest_part: Timing combat and platforming from intermittent screenshots while the game continues during deliberation. Fixed 0.4-second inputs make precise dodges, landing adjustments, and safe healing difficult. These probabilities are subjective estimates, not calibrated from prior runs.
interview.likely_failure: Repeated deaths or navigation loops at an early boss or traversal bottleneck, consuming the three-hour budget before reaching enough regions and ability unlocks. I expect exploration and ordinary-enemy milestones to contribute more reliably than boss progression.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Deaths allow continued play rather than ending the attempt. Benches restore health and establish checkpoints, and hitting enemies replenishes silk for healing. Scoring spans exploration, kills, resources, and interactions, allowing partial credit without completing the whole route. Rosaries in the cocoon still count toward their thresholds.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Enemy attacks and hazards remain active while I think. Mandatory directional input and coarse action durations restrict positioning and timing. Death sends Hornet back to the last checkpoint, potentially requiring substantial retraversal. Dash is unavailable initially, ability gates restrict routes, and binding requires silk plus a safe opportunity.
